name: Breadcrumbs
description: A breadcrumb trail above the page content, built from the page address and your page titles, with BreadcrumbList structured data for search engines. Hidden on the home page.

panels.title: Breadcrumbs
panels.description: The trail of links above your page content, like Home › Blog › This post. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Show breadcrumbs
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: home-label
fields.title: Name of the home page
fields.description: The first link in the trail. Leave empty for Home.

fields.name: color
fields.title: Link colour
fields.description: Leave empty for dark teal (#0f766e), which is easy to read on a light page.

fields.name: show-current
fields.title: Show the current page at the end
fields.description: Its title, not a link, marked as the current page for screen readers.

fields.name: structured-data
fields.title: Add structured data for search engines
fields.description: BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, so Google can show the trail in search results.

fields.name: exclude
fields.title: Pages to skip
fields.description: Slugs, separated by commas, that never get breadcrumbs. The home page never does; if yours has a slug other than home, add it here. For example: contact, thank-you
